sources.name: UK ETS HSE status guidance
facts: HSEs have annual emissions targets for each scheme year
2026-30 HSE applications were made in April-June 2025 baseline window
for hospital-service eligibility at least 85% of heat is used by or supplied to hospitals

sources.name: UK ETS HSE how to comply
facts: HSEs monitor GHGE each scheme year
report GHGE by 31 March following year
must not exceed annual emissions target

sources.name: HSE emissions and targets 2021-25
facts: lists regulator, annual targets and actual emissions

sources.name: UK ETS ultra-small emitter guidance
facts: USE threshold is below 2,500 tCO2e for qualifying scheme years
if emissions exceed 2,500 tCO2e they must notify regulator and can lose USE status

global_operations: HSE and USE obligations aligned across official guidance
Eligibility threshold not treated as actual emissions
Installation compliance data not promoted to parcel
